plugin.name: Bodycam item (battery powered)
plugin.description: Adds a Body Camera item sold by general traders. The bodycam effect only runs while you carry a charged camera anywhere in your inventory; it drains in real time and takes standard batteries (drag a battery onto it). Battery life is set in MCM (Zone Bodycam: Item). The REC timer keeps counting while the camera is off. Leave unchecked to keep the bodycam always on.
